input: How many UAT suites does tests/uat define?
output: tests/uat defines four suites, A through D: A is the CLI surface (suites/a-cli.mjs), B is the MCP tool surface over real stdio (suites/b-mcp.mjs), C is the HTTP surface (suites/c-http.mjs), and D is the dashboard surface driven by Playwright/chromium (suites/d-dashboard.mjs). run-uat.mjs runs all four by default (--suite A,C selects a subset) and then appends its own G block for harness isolation and artifact freshness, which is why UAT-REPORT.md shows five sections.
